newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares track Wall St. down but rally seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares track Wall St. down but rally seen.

text.p: Danish share prices followed U.S. stocks down in Wednesday's opening trade but dealers saw continued foreign interest in bank stocks and drug group Novo Nordisk's first quarter results giving a boost later.
"We'll go down a bit during the morning but by midday the banks will most probably lift the market again. Otherwise we'll be waiting for Novo's accounts to give direction," a dealer said.
At 0730 GMT the KFX top-20 index was down 0.40 point, to 162.63. Its June future fell 0.45 point to 162.80
